title: Add a drift guard (doctor check + test)
description: Add a doctor check that .agent/plan-interview.md exists and is referenced from the operator surfaces, and a test in tests/appbuilder.test.js asserting the guide's presence and that the /plan command references it. Written test-first.
acceptance_criteria: doctor reports an ok line when the interview guide exists and is referenced, and a fail line when it is missing or unreferenced.
A test asserts the guide exists and that .claude/commands/plan.md references it.
